author: The Current
description:
Watch Nur-D and his full band perform "Unannounced" live onstage
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

On Friday, April 3, Nur-D lit up the stage at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul with a full-band set of his energetic and innovative brand of hip-hop, including the song "Unannounced," above. 

The set was part of The Current Presents Minnesota Music Month featuring: NUR-D, runo plum, and Agnes Uncaged with Special Appearances by jeremy messersmith, Singing Resistance Twin Cities, and the High School for Recording Arts Students.

Watch Nur-D’s full set here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okf1IZECKPk 

Musicians
Nur-D – vocals
DJ Hayes – DJ
Saxy Dave – saxophone
Tuvok the Word – drums
Brotha Ivory – keyboard
Mr. Pants – saxophone
Highstylekyle – trumpet
El Parcero – bass guitar
Alice Daytona – guitar

Credits
Video – Josh Sauvageau, Maurizio D'Errico
Audio – Evan Clark, Maurizio D'Errico
Digital Producers – Reed Fischer, Luke Taylor

author: The Current
description:
Shelley Quiala and Dayna Martinez stopped by The Current’s Morning Show to talk about Minneapolis Mile of Music. The musical events will take place today, Wednesday, August 19, at about 25 locations in northeast Minneapolis, through downtown, Loring Park and Eat Street.

#TheCurrentMorningShow #Minneapolis #DowntownMinneapolis #MileofMusicMpls
title: Shelley Quiala and Dayna Martinez on Minneapolis Mile of Music #MinneapolisMileofMusic
